proposals.title: Proposal A: Street Loop + Summit Jump
proposals.notes: Street Loop Forward; at the Lake shore junction round the lake south shore onto the Mountain return trail, the ridge, the summit approach and the summit jump, down to the lake and back to the Street Loop

proposals.title: Proposal B: Street Loop Reverse + Ridge Loop
proposals.notes: Street Loop Reverse; at the Lake shore junction round the lake north shore, the Mountain return trail the other way (north arc, east slope, ridge), the lake south shore back to the Street Loop
